item.title: Lotte Non-Life Insurance shares suspended from trading on 19 November 2026 at 16:49 over a capital reduction of 10% or more; trading resumes 20 November.
Lotte Non-Life Insurance's board decided a 90% bonus capital reduction, cutting par value per share from KRW 1,000 to KRW 100.
